name: Dow
verdict: Dow is Dow Inc. (NYSE: DOW). UN experts and Amnesty International say the contamination left at Union Carbide's Bhopal plant, which Dow now owns, still poisons half a million people.
note: Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Proposed tier: concern. The link: the team's Official Materials Science Partner (Jaguar TCS Racing launch release, 22 Oct 2025) is Dow Inc. itself — the listed company whose holding-company structure and NYSE listing are quoted from its Form 10-K FY2025, with Vanguard (11.4%) and BlackRock (6.6%) as its 5%+ holders (2026 proxy; corroborated by Vanguard's 13G/A). No state holds 5%+. The record: UN human-rights experts (December 2024) said the company now owned by The Dow Chemical Company dumped and mismanaged hazardous waste at Bhopal, creating a sacrifice zone where pollution continues to poison people; Amnesty International's March 2024 report 'Bhopal: 40 years of Injustice' documents the same ongoing abuse of communities. That is a human-rights finding against the company itself (abuse of communities, still going on), so the proposal is concern (METHOD.md).

why.text: The team's partner Dow is Dow Inc., the listed company that is the holding company of The Dow Chemical Company. UN human-rights experts said in December 2024 that the company now owned by The Dow Chemical Company dumped and mismanaged hazardous waste at its Bhopal pesticide facility, creating a sacrifice zone where pollution continues to poison people, many living in poverty; Amnesty International's 2024 report says Dow and the US and Indian authorities have created a sacrifice zone in which half a million people across multiple generations are suffering.
why.messageLine: UN experts say the pollution left at the Bhopal plant of the company Dow now owns still poisons half a million people.
